pulls.title: 8394862: RISC-V: Select arraycopy LMUL based on VLEN
pulls.author: zifeihan
pulls.body_excerpt: This patch adjusts the LMUL used by the RISC-V `copy_memory_v` arraycopy stub according to the hardware VLEN. The previous implementation always used LMUL=m8. However, the effective vector-group capacity is `VLEN * LMUL`, so the same LMUL behaves differently across implementations: - On sg2044 (`VLEN=128 bits`), m8 provides a 128-byte vector group. - On K3 (`VLEN=256 bits`), m8 provides a 256-byte vector group, while m4 provides 128 bytes. The patch therefore selects LMUL when the stub is generated: - `MaxVectorSize == 16`: use m8 - otherwise: use m4 ### Performance test with release on Spacem

pulls.title: 8394736: C2: Trap profile pollution can disable Preconditions.checkIndex intrinsification
pulls.author: merykitty
pulls.activity: 新建、1 个 Review、5 条评论
pulls.body_excerpt: Hi, When C2 tries to intrinsify `Preconditions::checkIndex`, it first checks `too_many_traps`. This method returns `false` when it has recorded a trap at the current `JVMState`. For an intrinsics, the `JVMState` is the state right before the call to that intrinsics, such as the state at the start of `Objects::checkIndex`. This is harmful, because `Objects::checkIndex` may be used, not only inside core library code, but also in user code, which means that a failed range check would disable intrinsification of all other calls to `Objects::checkIndex`, such as `ArrayList::get`.
